sloka: यो वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातान्न चुक्षुभे नापि चचाल राजा ।स रामबाणाभिहतो भृशार्तश्चचाल चापं च मुमोच वीरः ।। ६.५९.१४० ।।।।
transliteration: yo vajrapātāśanisannipātānna cukṣubhe nāpi cacāla rājā ।sa rāmabāṇābhihato bhṛśārtaścacāla cāpaṁ ca mumoca vīraḥ ।। 6.59.140 ।।।।

translations.english: He, that heroic king, who was not disturbed hurt by thunderbolt of lightning, was agonized when struck by Rama's arrow and let his bow fall.
